children: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Monday that he would meet with his Canadian counterpart on the sidelines of a meeting of G20 finance ministers and central bank governors, adding that the U.S. was not in a war with Canada.
"I think this is very unfortunate that Prime Minister Carney has turned this into a political shouting match. I mean, we're not at war with Canada," Bessent told CNBC in an interview.
